name: smwblocks-autoslide-slope
title: Autoslide Slope
description:
Block which causes Mario to automatically slide (and locks left/right inputs in the process). Intended for slopes, but could technically be used with any block Mario can stand on.

Also includes a version which only cause Mario to autoslide depending on a certain switch (e.g. ON/OFF switch, blue/silver P-switch, star power, etc.), in case you want to do a trap staircase or something.
